chapterInfo.content:
29
Nhyira ne ɔsɛeɛ
1 # Mmb 15.10 Onipa a wɔka n’anim na ɔsene ne kɔn no,
wɔbɛbu no mpofirim
a ano nni aduro.
2 # Mmb 11.10 Ateneneefoɔ di tumi a, ɔman ani gye,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ di so a, ɔman si apini.
3 # Luka 15.13 Onipa a ɔdɔ nyansa ma n’agya ani gye,
na deɛ ɔne nnwamamfoɔ bɔ bɛsɛe n’adeɛ.
4 # Yes 32.7 Ɔhene de atemmuo ma asase gyina,
na akyɛdepɛfoɔ bɔ no.
5Onipa a ɔdɛfɛdɛfɛ ne yɔnko no,
ɔsum n’anammɔn fidie.
6Onipa bɔne mmarato mu wɔ fidie,
na ɔteneneeni bɛto ahurisie dwom, na n’ani agye.
7Ɔteneneeni hunu mmɔborɔfoɔ asɛm di,
ɔbɔnefoɔ nhunu saa nimdeɛ no.
8Fɛdifoɔ sɔ kuro mu gya,
na anyansafoɔ sianka abufuo.
9 # Mat 11.17 Ɔba nyansafoɔ ne ogyimifoɔ di apereɛ a,
ɔyɛ hoo oo, ɔsere oo, home nni mu.
10Mogyapɛfoɔ tane pɛyɛfoɔ,
na teefoɔ hwehwɛ ne kra agye no.
11 # Mmb 25.28; 12.23 Ɔkwasea yi ne honhom nyinaa adi,
na onyansafoɔ dwodwo no ma no ka akyi.
12Ɔpanin a ɔtie atorosɛm no,
n’asomfo nyinaa yɛ abɔnefoɔ.
13Adekoro bi da nso wɔ ohiani ne opooboni ntɛm,
deɛ ɔte wɔn baanu nyinaa ani ne AWURADE.
14 # Mmb 16.12 Ɔhene a ɔbu nokwatɛn ma mmɔborɔfoɔ no,
n’ahennwa bɛtim daa.
15 # Mmb 29.17; 22.15 Abaa ne animka ma nyansa,
na abɔfra a wɔato no sraha gu ne na anim ase.
16 # Dwom 37.36 Abɔnefoɔ dɔɔso a, mmarato dɔɔso,
nanso ateneneefoɔ bɛhunu wɔn ahweaseɛ.
17 # Mmb 23.13 Tenetene wo ba na wama woahome,
na wama wo kra anika.
18Anisoadehunu nni hɔ a, ɔman yɛ bisibasaa,
nanso deɛ ɔbu mmara no, nhyira ne no.
19Ɛnyɛ nsɛm na wɔde tea akoa,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔte aseɛ mpo a, ɔremmu.
20 # Ɔsɛ 5.2-3; Yak 1.19 Wohunu onipa a ɔpere ne nsɛm ho a,
anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ ma ɔkwasea sene no.
21Deɛ ɔkorɔkorɔ n’akoa firi ne mmɔfraase no,
akyire yi no ɔbɛyɛ sɛ ɔba.
22 # Mmb 15.18; 26.21 Obufufafoɔ hwanyan ntɔkwa,
na ɔbobɔnefoɔ mmarato dɔɔso.
23 # Mat 23.12; 1 Pe 5.5 Onipa ahantan bɛbrɛ no ase,
na honhom mu ahobrɛaseɛni nsa bɛka animuonyam.
24 # Lew 5.1 Deɛ ɔne owifoɔ kyɛ adeɛ no tane ne kra,
ɔte duabɔ no nso ɔnka.
25Onipa ho suro sum fidie,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no ho deɛ ɔbɛyɛ sɔnn.
26Nnipa pii hwehwɛ ɔman sodifoɔ anim animuonyam,
nanso AWURADE na obiara atemmuo firi no.
27Ateneneefoɔ akyiwadeɛ ne busufoɔ,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ nso akyiwadeɛ ne deɛ ne kwan yɛ tee.

pageProps.chapterText:
Onipa a wɔka n’anim na ɔsene ne kɔn no,
wɔbɛbu no mpofirim
a ano nni aduro.
Ateneneefoɔ di tumi a, ɔman ani gye,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ di so a, ɔman si apini.
Onipa a ɔdɔ nyansa ma n’agya ani gye,
na deɛ ɔne nnwamamfoɔ bɔ bɛsɛe n’adeɛ.
Ɔhene de atemmuo ma asase gyina,
na akyɛdepɛfoɔ bɔ no.
Onipa a ɔdɛfɛdɛfɛ ne yɔnko no,
ɔsum n’anammɔn fidie.
Onipa bɔne mmarato mu wɔ fidie,
na ɔteneneeni bɛto ahurisie dwom, na n’ani agye.
Ɔteneneeni hunu mmɔborɔfoɔ asɛm di,
ɔbɔnefoɔ nhunu saa nimdeɛ no.
Fɛdifoɔ sɔ kuro mu gya,
na anyansafoɔ sianka abufuo.
Ɔba nyansafoɔ ne ogyimifoɔ di apereɛ a,
ɔyɛ hoo oo, ɔsere oo, home nni mu.
Mogyapɛfoɔ tane pɛyɛfoɔ,
na teefoɔ hwehwɛ ne kra agye no.
Ɔkwasea yi ne honhom nyinaa adi,
na onyansafoɔ dwodwo no ma no ka akyi.
Ɔpanin a ɔtie atorosɛm no,
n’asomfo nyinaa yɛ abɔnefoɔ.
Adekoro bi da nso wɔ ohiani ne opooboni ntɛm,
deɛ ɔte wɔn baanu nyinaa ani ne AWURADE.
Ɔhene a ɔbu nokwatɛn ma mmɔborɔfoɔ no,
n’ahennwa bɛtim daa.
Abaa ne animka ma nyansa,
na abɔfra a wɔato no sraha gu ne na anim ase.
Abɔnefoɔ dɔɔso a, mmarato dɔɔso,
nanso ateneneefoɔ bɛhunu wɔn ahweaseɛ.
Tenetene wo ba na wama woahome,
na wama wo kra anika.
Anisoadehunu nni hɔ a, ɔman yɛ bisibasaa,
nanso deɛ ɔbu mmara no, nhyira ne no.
Ɛnyɛ nsɛm na wɔde tea akoa,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔte aseɛ mpo a, ɔremmu.
Wohunu onipa a ɔpere ne nsɛm ho a,
anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ ma ɔkwasea sene no.
Deɛ ɔkorɔkorɔ n’akoa firi ne mmɔfraase no,
akyire yi no ɔbɛyɛ sɛ ɔba.
Obufufafoɔ hwanyan ntɔkwa,
na ɔbobɔnefoɔ mmarato dɔɔso.
Onipa ahantan bɛbrɛ no ase,
na honhom mu ahobrɛaseɛni nsa bɛka animuonyam.
Deɛ ɔne owifoɔ kyɛ adeɛ no tane ne kra,
ɔte duabɔ no nso ɔnka.
Onipa ho suro sum fidie,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no ho deɛ ɔbɛyɛ sɔnn.
Nnipa pii hwehwɛ ɔman sodifoɔ anim animuonyam,
nanso AWURADE na obiara atemmuo firi no.
Ateneneefoɔ akyiwadeɛ ne busufoɔ,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ nso akyiwadeɛ ne deɛ ne kwan yɛ tee.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
